_comment: Model mapping. The ONLY place model IDs appear. Prices are USD per million tokens; update when Anthropic changes pricing.

haiku.label: Haiku
haiku.blurb: Fastest and cheapest. Fine for quick, simple replies.

sonnet.label: Sonnet
sonnet.blurb: Best balance of quality and cost. Recommended.

opus.label: Opus
opus.blurb: Most careful writing for delicate or important emails. Costs about twice Sonnet.
